name: No hardware acceleration · software emulation (example)
author: ApkStart
description: When the Hypervisor Platform is off and kernel drivers cannot be installed, the emulator fails outright with hardware acceleration. This patch makes ApkStart start in software emulation (-accel off), skipping two long waits, and switches the renderer to software to avoid GL initialization failures.

notes: Software emulation is 5-10x slower than hardware acceleration; if you can enable virtualization, tick Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features instead
